In a within-subjects design, participants were scanned while making risky monetary choices in each of two conditions.

description.value: Participants made forced monetary choices between gambles and guaranteed alternatives under Attend and Regulate strategies, followed by monetary outcomes.

spans.text: Participants made a series of forced monetary choices between gambles (winning or losing with equal P = 0.5) and a guaranteed alternative ( P = 1), with outcome screens following each choice.
‘Attend’ condition
In the ‘Attend’ condition, participants considered each choice on its own merit, as if it was the only choice they were making.

description.value: Participants considered each choice in isolation from any context.

spans.text: For the ‘Attend’ strategy, participants were asked to consider each choice in isolation from any context, as if it was the only choice in the entire study.
‘Regulate’ condition
In the ‘Regulate’ condition, participants took a broader perspective and considered each choice in its greater context, as one of many.

description.value: Participants considered each choice in a greater context, as one of many or part of a portfolio.

spans.text: For the ‘Regulate’ strategy, participants were asked to consider each choice in a greater context, remembering that each choice was one of many or part of a portfolio.
